name: Article Card
summary: Native article summary that composes canonical Card and Badge, exposes independent layout and surface axes, and uses one native Link containing its contextual media and complete title.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native self-contained article summary composed on the canonical Card root.

anatomy.name: categorySlot
anatomy.description: Optional category placement outside the primary Link; overlays contextual media when present or precedes the Link when absent.

anatomy.name: category
anatomy.description: Optional passive canonical Badge; never part of the article destination name.

anatomy.name: primaryLink
anatomy.description: Only required article destination; contains the media, passive summary content, and complete contextual title without interactive descendants.

anatomy.name: layout
anatomy.description: Private media/body layout that responds to the root inline-size container.

anatomy.name: media
anatomy.description: Optional non-interactive target media contained by the primary Link and composed with canonical Card media.

anatomy.name: body
anatomy.description: Canonical Card body containing passive metadata, title, and optional excerpt within the primary Link.

anatomy.name: metadata
anatomy.description: Optional passive target-formatted publication date, duration, or taxonomy metadata.

anatomy.name: metadataSeparator
anatomy.description: Optional visual-only separator between metadata values.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Complete visible contextual heading inside the primary Link; rank is selected by target composition.

anatomy.name: excerpt
anatomy.description: Optional supplied summary; source text remains intact while an explicit excerptLines presentation may visually clamp it.

anatomy.name: author
anatomy.description: Optional canonical Card footer outside the primary Link for target-owned author identity or independent destinations.

anatomy.name: authorName
anatomy.description: Optional author-name text inside the target author composition.

variants.name: standard
variants.description: Default vertical article layout independent from Card surface.

variants.name: featured
variants.description: Higher-emphasis layout that splits media/body only when its own container is wide enough.

variants.name: minimal
variants.description: Text-led layout that omits media presentation without changing the selected Card surface.

variants.name: horizontal
variants.description: Compact media/body layout that stacks when its own container is narrow.

variants.name: editorial
variants.description: Accent-family title treatment with unchanged native semantics and independent Card surface.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Fluid intrinsic size controlled by the parent and Article Card container.

states.name: default
states.description: Canonical default Card surface with standard layout and complete article destination.

states.name: flatSurface
states.description: Canonical card--flat dependency class and data-surface=flat remain independent from Article Card layout profile.

states.name: elevatedSurface
states.description: Canonical card--elevated dependency class and data-surface=elevated remain independent from Article Card layout profile.

states.name: withoutMedia
states.description: Optional media is omitted while the title remains in the one primary Link.

states.name: excerptComplete
states.description: data-excerpt-lines=none renders the complete supplied excerpt without a clamp.

states.name: excerptClamped
states.description: Explicit two-, three-, or four-line visual fitting preserves the source text in DOM.

states.name: linkHover
states.description: The complete primary destination gains a title underline; no JavaScript root delegation is used.

states.name: linkFocus
states.description: Visible keyboard focus surrounds the one native primary Link.

behavior.name: nativeArticleSummary
behavior.description: Use native article and contextual heading elements without a Card widget role or custom keyboard model.

behavior.name: linkedMediaAndTitle
behavior.description: One native Link contains the contextual media and complete title as one article destination; the root never forwards activation.

behavior.name: interactiveDescendantBoundary
behavior.description: The primary Link contains no nested interactive content. Passive category and any independent author or future action destination remain outside it.

behavior.name: canonicalCardComposition
behavior.description: Runtime markup adds canonical card, card__media, card__body, card__footer, card--flat, and card--elevated dependency classes. Card owns surface, border, shadow, radius, hover, focus-within clipping, media treatment, and reduced motion; Article Card owns article layout/content only.

behavior.name: externalSkeletonBoundary
behavior.description: Loading composes canonical Skeleton externally and replaces it with Article Card only when authoritative article data exists. L1 has no loading variant, busy lifecycle, or internal Skeleton markup.

behavior.name: contextualMedia
behavior.description: Media is non-interactive; the target supplies informative alt text or an explicit empty value according to context.

behavior.name: targetMetadata
behavior.description: Dates, durations, taxonomy, author identity, locale, and independent destinations are supplied and formatted by the target; no reading time is inferred.

behavior.name: canonicalBadgeComposition
behavior.description: Category composes canonical passive Badge visuals outside the primary Link; Article Card owns placement only.

behavior.name: intrinsicVariantLayout
behavior.description: Featured and horizontal layouts respond to the Article Card named inline-size container rather than viewport or Studio breakpoints.

behavior.name: excerptFitting
behavior.description: none renders the complete supplied excerpt; 2, 3, or 4 applies an explicit CSS visual line clamp without mutating target content.

behavior.name: passiveRuntime
behavior.description: Neutral Article Card owns no JavaScript, request, observer, timer, storage, link delegation, animation loop, or analytics behavior.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: One of the five accepted Article Card layout profiles, independent from surface.

properties.name: surface
properties.description: Canonical Card surface variant, mapped to default, card--flat, or card--elevated without duplicating Card visual properties.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Complete visible contextual article heading and primary Link name.

properties.name: href
properties.description: Single native article destination used by the primary Link containing media and title.

properties.name: media
properties.description: Target-owned non-interactive article picture, image, or media composition inside the primary Link.

properties.name: imageAlt
properties.unsetBehavior: Use an empty alt value only when the image is decorative or duplicates adjacent article information; otherwise supply contextual informative text.
properties.description: Alternative text for the target image inside the media slot.

properties.name: category
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the category slot and Badge when no passive category label is supplied.
properties.description: Optional passive article category composed with canonical Badge outside the primary Link.

properties.name: metadata
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the metadata wrapper when no target-formatted passive values are supplied.
properties.description: Target-owned passive publication date, duration, or taxonomy composition; use machine-readable time elements where applicable and place interactive metadata outside the primary Link.

properties.name: excerpt
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the paragraph when no excerpt is available.
properties.description: Optional supplied article summary; source content remains intact regardless of visual fitting.

properties.name: excerptLines
properties.description: Complete excerpt or explicit two-, three-, or four-line visual clamp without source mutation.

properties.name: author
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the canonical Card footer when no author composition is supplied.
properties.description: Target-owned author identity and optional independent destination outside the primary Link.

accessibility: Use a native article root and a contextual heading level selected by the surrounding composition; do not add a Card widget role or custom keyboard model.
Render exactly one native primary Link containing contextual media and the complete visible title. Do not add nested interactive descendants or JavaScript whole-card delegation.
Keep passive category Badge, author destinations, and any future independent actions outside the primary Link.
Supply contextual informative image alt text or an explicit empty value when the image is decorative or redundant; media itself adds no second destination.
Use machine-readable time datetime values for dates and durations when present, hide visual-only separators, and never infer reading time in neutral source.
Treat excerptLines as visual fitting only. Keep complete source text in DOM and ensure essential meaning is not available only after the clamp point.
Preserve visible Link focus around the linked summary, normal Tab order, Card descendant-focus visibility, forced-colors contrast, coarse-pointer behavior, and reduced motion.
Compose canonical Skeleton externally while loading; Article Card has no aria-busy state, loading variant, or internal placeholder anatomy.

web.notes: Native article/heading/one-Link markup composes canonical Card and Badge, independent surface/layout axes, explicit excerpt fitting, intrinsic layout, and zero neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: The article-card snippet maps Shopify article title, URL, image, published timestamp, excerpt, author, explicit display flags, heading rank, layout, Card surface, excerpt lines, and optional passed blog label without inferred reading time or JavaScript.

react.notes: Preserve the one-Link media/title composition and let the target router own navigation interception or prefetch.

figma.notes: Compose canonical Card and Badge with independent five-profile, three-surface, excerpt-fitting, optional-part, and long-content states; registered nodes still reference generic Button shells.
